Subject: Intro + exec demo — CTO availability request

Hi Rachel,

Thanks for taking this. We're excited to evaluate Redwood Inference for a pilot — our CTO (Evan Cole) and VP of Eng would like to see the platform focused on low-latency inference and cost controls. Would you and a solutions sponsor be available for a 45-minute executive demo the week of May 27? Evan specifically asked for a short run through of:
- Serving runtime and latency SLOs (10–30 minute deep-dive)
- Dedicated vs hosted tradeoffs
- Rollout/fallback strategies for high-availability

Proposed windows (all ET):
- Thu May 30, 11:00–11:45
- Mon Jun 3, 14:00–14:45

If you can do either, would love a 30-minute pre-brief with your sponsor the day prior so we can align on the agenda. Attaching our draft agenda and your deck would be great.

Attaches: redwood-demo-deck.pdf (pdf)

Thanks,
Tara Lewis
Enterprise Programs — Avery Systems
T: 415-555-0123
